name: ams OSRAM
old_description: Since 1906, the OSRAM brand has stood for continuous progress through light. On its 120th anniversary, it looks back on a unique history of innovation — and, as part of ams OSRAM, looks ahead to the world of Digital Photonics.
about:
ams OSRAM traces its roots to the OSRAM brand, established in 1906 in Germany. Today the company is headquartered in Premstaetten/Graz, Austria, with a co-headquarters in Munich, Germany, and a significant U.S. presence in Novi, Michigan. The business operates as a publicly traded global corporation with approximately 18,500 employees worldwide.

The company designs and manufactures semiconductor-based light emitters, optical sensors, CMOS integrated circuits, and related software, along with traditional lighting technologies for automotive and specialty applications. Its product portfolio includes VCSELs, infrared LEDs, UV-C LEDs, time-of-flight sensors, LiDAR lasers, and LED driver ICs, produced through global manufacturing capabilities and protected by a portfolio of around 12,000 patents.

ams OSRAM serves the automotive, industrial, medical, consumer electronics, mobile and wearables, lighting, and computing sectors. In automotive, its SYNIOS P2222 LEDs set a new standard for signaling, while its OSIRE E3030 RGB LEDs enable advanced interior lighting. In consumer health, Korean baby-care brand UPANG adopts the company's UV-C LED technology for bottle sterilization. The firm also supplies optical interconnects for AI data centers and LiDAR solutions for autonomous vehicles.

The company positions itself as a "Photonics Powerhouse," differentiating through its combination of light emission, detection, and intelligence — what it calls Digital Photonics. Its mission emphasizes pioneering lighting and sensing technologies that make the world safer, smarter, and more sustainable, backed by a culture of innovation, trust, and speed.
